title: Frontend Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
At go-e, we have been pursuing the development of our vision with passion and strength from the very beginning. We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth.

Help build the Portal, a modern web platform for fleet managers and technicians. As a Frontend Engineer (m/f/x), you will turn product ideas into responsive, accessible interfaces using React and TypeScript. Join a collaborative team that values autonomy, ownership, code quality, and learning, and deliver features with visible customer impact.

With your contribution, you will impact how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join the team in Berlin (GER) that is building the future of innovative charger solutions for e-mobility!

Your area of responsibility

  • Build and deliver frontend features for the Portal using React and TypeScript.
  • Work with product, design, and backend specialists to translate requirements into user interfaces.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and WebSocket communication, including asynchronous data, caching, and error handling.
  • Write clean, maintainable, performant code and unit and integration tests.
  • Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and frontend architectural decisions.
  • Troubleshoot existing features, improve performance, and share knowledge with other engineers.

Who we’re looking for:

  • Strong experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience with server-side rendering frameworks such as Next.js.
  • Proficiency with modern frontend tooling and state management, such as Redux or React Context.
  • Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, CSS-in-JS or styled-components, and responsive or adaptive design.
  • Familiarity with UI component libraries, design systems, and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience with frontend build tools such as Webpack, Vite, or Babel, including bundler optimization.
  • Ability to integrate APIs and WebSocket communication and manage asynchronous data flows, errors, and caching.
  • An independent approach, ownership of your work, and clear communication with product, design, and engineering colleagues.

Even better would be

  • Experience writing developer tools, internal packages, or SDKs.
  • Contributions to open-source projects.
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced environments.
  • Deeper familiarity with real-time or WebSocket architectures.
  • (Not a must) Proficiency in one or more backend languages / frameworks (e.g. Node.js / Express / NestJS / TypeScript, or similar)

What we offer

  • Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
  • A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
  • Flexible working hours
  • Mental well-being support via nilo.health
  • Employee discounts on our products
  • Corporate discounts on a variety of brands
About go-e
We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

title: Senior Media Relations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day.

You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold.

Journalists respond to people they know and trust, not to mass pitches, and the strongest coverage comes from a specialist who holds those relationships personally. Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. Done well, it builds the company's reputation with the people who cover our industry over the long term.

What you would do

  • Build and maintain direct relationships with journalists across hospitality, travel, technology and business media: develop stories with the communications team, pitch them proactively by phone and email, host press briefings and invite journalists to events such as Unfold.
  • Respond to inbound press enquiries (currently two to three a week and growing) quickly and accurately, and escalate anything potentially sensitive to the communications lead straight away.
  • Brief and coach executive and local spokespeople, and share what you learn from journalists with leadership.
  • Redesign how media monitoring, journalist research and coverage reporting work using AI, and set the workflows up so the rest of the team can use them.
  • Own and improve the team's media management tool, and check every AI-assisted pitch, briefing or summary before it reaches a journalist.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means you have gone well beyond using AI to draft copy. You have redesigned parts of how media relations work gets done, such as monitoring, journalist research or coverage reporting, you have built approaches that colleagues now follow, and you actively question and check what AI gives you, including target lists, summaries and quotes, before anything reaches a journalist or a spokesperson.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

What you would bring

  • Seven to ten years in PR and communications with depth in B2B media relations, including time in a PR agency.
  • Your own journalist contacts and hands-on experience pitching by phone, email and in person, with fully fluent English, written and spoken.
  • A record of handling reactive and sensitive press enquiries under time pressure, with clear habits about when to escalate.
  • Confidence preparing senior and non-expert spokespeople for press conversations.
  • AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience, shown through tools or workflows you have built for media relations work, not only content you have written with AI.

Nice to have

  • French or German alongside fluent English, or existing relationships with journalists in the UK, France, Germany or the US.
  • Experience with B2B technology clients or in hospitality.
  • Experience measuring coverage and coordinating local expertise in markets where you have fewer contacts.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development

  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. Job Description The Software Engineer (.NET/Azure) is a hands-on, mid-level contributor responsible for designing, building, and modernizing high-volume, high-transaction applications across the Experian Employer Services (EES) organization. You will write production code, participate in code reviews, evaluate SAST findings, and work closely with product, quality engineering, security, and operations partners to deliver secure, reliable software to our clients and partners. AI and automation are the main focus of our team. EES is adopting an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) and spec-driven agentic development, in which teams define intent, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation before AI agents build approved work. As an engineer in this model you will work from versioned specifications, direct AI coding agents to implement approved work, and oversee the review, testing, and security validation of what they produce. You will have already worked this way hands-on; this is a requirement of the role, not a learning goal. Humans remain accountable for technical decisions, data protection, and production outcomes. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. This hybrid role reports to the Engineering Manager, Application Engineering, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA Responsibilities: Analyze new feature requirements with attention to design, software development best practices, testing strategy, database design, security, and cloud architecture, and turn them into clear, versioned specifications with explicit acceptance criteria that engineers and AI agents can verify. Use AI coding assistants and agents (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to implement approved work, and own the review, testing, and security validation of AI-generated code before it is merged. Decide when a change needs additional human review based on its risk. Build new and modernize existing .NET applications, APIs, and partner integrations, including responsive, accessible web UIs that work across devices. Write high-quality, well-tested code: unit tests, integration tests, and contract tests, with observability built in. Automate repetitive engineering and operational work (pipelines, environment setup, test data, deployments) rather than performing it by hand. Maintain the team's reusable agent instructions, skills, and coding standards for the codebase, and help teammates use agentic tools well. Participate in code reviews and provide meaningful feedback on human-written and AI-generated code alike. Follow Experian's Secure SDLC. Evaluate and resolve SAST findings, handle sensitive and personal data safely, and never expose such data to AI tools or non-production environments without approved controls. Resolve defects identified by quality engineering and demonstrate completed functionality to the Product team for approval. Promote a DevOps culture, work with IT and operations, and participate in the on-call rotation for platform emergencies. Work within Agile and Scrum delivery while adapting planning and reporting as specifications and system-generated evidence replace ceremony-driven tracking. Qualifications Hands-on experience with spec-driven agentic development (mandatory). At least one year of personally using AI coding assistants or agents on production code: working from specifications, constraining the agent's scope, testing and reviewing its output, and deciding what requires human approval. Experience working within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) or a comparable spec-driven model with explicit specifications, automated validation, and human oversight. 6+ years of professional .NET development experience with C#, .NET 8+ (and .NET Framework for maintenance of existing systems), and ASP.NET Core. 2+ years building and operating solutions on Azure, including services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor. Experience with MS SQL Server, T-SQL, relational database design, and Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM. Experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and partner integrations, including authentication, versioning, and error handling. Solid front-end experience with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and one modern SPA framework (Angular or React). Experience with service oriented or microservice architecture, messaging, and common cloud-native patterns. Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, Git branching workflows, and automated testing in the pipeline. Working knowledge of secure coding practices, SAST remediation, and handling of sensitive and personal data. Experience with Agile and Scrum delivery. Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience building GenAI-enabled features with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or similar, including retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and output evaluation.
